description: This Java file defines the ReceiptService class, which contains business logic for managing receipt documents, including uploading, versioning, OCR processing, search, and metadata extraction.

classes.name: ReceiptService
classes.description: Service class encapsulating business logic for receipt document handling, OCR, categorization, versioning, and search.

methods.name: uploadNewDocument
methods.description: Uploads a new receipt document, initializes metadata, performs OCR, and saves it.

methods.name: uploadNewVersion
methods.description: Adds a new version to an existing document, performs OCR, and updates metadata.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Retrieves a document by its ID.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Returns the version history of a document.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search for documents based on user ID and optional filters, with in-memory text filtering.

methods.name: triggerOcr
methods.description: Re-runs OCR on the latest version of a document, extracting key fields.
